text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein seeks clarification on the state of Jordanian prisoners in Kuwait, confirmns need for commitment to international laws on detention.
- Engineer's Union plans three-hour stoppage on February 22 to pressure government into implementation of agreement covering salary bonuses and grades.
- Crown Prince Hassan and Prime Minister Kabariti meet Sweden's minister of state for foreign affairs. Prince Hassan affirms the need to achieve stability.
- Kabariti sends condolences to Algerian prime minister over slaying of union chief.
- King Hussein, in a letter to Copenhagen conference on Arab-Israeli peace process, calls on people of the region to support moves for a just and comprehensive peace.
- Court clears three journalists on weekly paper al-Ahali over articles in 1993 related to security services and a number of Arab leaders.
